> Independent free SpeedX package tracking and delivery help. Not affiliated with SpeedX.

## Direct answers
- Is SpeedX legit? Yes — real last-mile carrier; verify with SPX/SPXCN from your seller.
- SpeedX shipping times: domestic ~2–7 days; international ~7–20 days.
- Package not delivered: check scans → wait OFD day → search drop points → seller with screenshots.
